chapterInfo.content:
4
Elifas asɛnka a ɛdi kan.
Onyankopɔn ntwe deɛ ɔdi bem aso
1Ɛnna Temanni Elifas bua see sɛ:
2Sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔka asɛm yi ho bi kyerɛ wo a,
ɛbɛyɛ wo ahomete anaa?
Nanso mpo twa ara na ɛtwa sɛ ɔka?
3Hwɛ, wo na woatenetene nnipa bebree,
na nsa a agoɔ no, woahyɛ no den;
4wo nsɛm ama deɛ ɔrebɛhwe ase agyina,
na nankoroma a ahodwo no, wɔahyɛ no den.
5Na afei ɛtoo woɔ yi, woagyigya,
ɛkaa woɔ yi, woabɔ nnyinnyen.
6Ɛnyɛ wo Nyamesuro ne deɛ wode wo ho to soɔ,
na w’akwan a ɛtene ne w’anidasoɔ anaa?
7Kae ɛ, hwan na ɔnyɛɛ bɔne biara na wɔasɛe no pɛn,
anaa ɛhe na wɔatwa ateneneefoɔ atwene pɛn?
8 # Mmb 22.8 Manya nhunui sɛ wɔn a wɔfɛntɛm amumuyɛ
na wɔgu mmusuo no, ɛno ara na wɔtwa.
9Nyankopɔn home sɛe wɔn,
na wɔhye, n’abufuo mframa ano.
10Wote sɛ gyata mmobɔmu ne ɔsebɔ nne a ɛgyae,
na gyataburuwa sebɔmmɔfoɔ tutu no.
11Ɛno na hanam bɛbɔ ɛserɛ-mu-sɛe ama no awu,
na gyatabereɛ mma abɔ pete.
12Na me deɛ, asɛm bi wiawiaa ne ho baa me nkyɛn,
na m’aso tee ɛho asomusɛm bi.
13Ɔdadwene a ɛfiri anadwo adehunu mu mu,
berɛ a nnahɔɔ atɔ nnipa soɔ no,
14 # Gye 15.12 ehu ne ahopopoɔ kaa me,
na ɛmaa me nnompe nyinaa wosoe.
15Na honhom bi twaa mu faa m’ani so,
me ho nwi nyinaa sɔre gyinagyinae,
16ɛgyinae,
nanso manhunu ne su,
suban bi gyinagyina m’ani so,
metee nne bɔkɔɔ bi sɛ:
17Ɔdasani tene sene Onyankopɔn,
anaa onipa ho te sene ne yɛfoɔ?
18 # Hiob 15.15 Hwɛ, ne nkoa mpo, ɔmfa ne ho nto wɔn so,
na n’abɔfoɔ no, ɔbu wɔn sɛ wɔtɔ mu;
19 # 2 Ko 5.1 na nkantom wɔn a wɔte dɔteɛ adan mu,
na wɔn nnyinasoɔ wɔ mfuturo mu,
na wɔfurofuro wɔn sɛ abubummabaa.
20Ɛfiri anɔpa kɔsi anwummerɛ na wɔaposa wɔn;
wɔyera korakora a obi nnwene ho.
21Sɛ wɔtete wɔn ho ntomadan homa a,
ɛnyɛ wuo na wɔwuo a wɔanhunu nyansa biara?

Ɛnna Temanni Elifas bua see sɛ:
Sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔka asɛm yi ho bi kyerɛ wo a,
ɛbɛyɛ wo ahomete anaa?
Nanso mpo twa ara na ɛtwa sɛ ɔka?
Hwɛ, wo na woatenetene nnipa bebree,
na nsa a agoɔ no, woahyɛ no den;
wo nsɛm ama deɛ ɔrebɛhwe ase agyina,
na nankoroma a ahodwo no, wɔahyɛ no den.
Na afei ɛtoo woɔ yi, woagyigya,
ɛkaa woɔ yi, woabɔ nnyinnyen.
Ɛnyɛ wo Nyamesuro ne deɛ wode wo ho to soɔ,
na w’akwan a ɛtene ne w’anidasoɔ anaa?
Kae ɛ, hwan na ɔnyɛɛ bɔne biara na wɔasɛe no pɛn,
anaa ɛhe na wɔatwa ateneneefoɔ atwene pɛn?
Manya nhunui sɛ wɔn a wɔfɛntɛm amumuyɛ
na wɔgu mmusuo no, ɛno ara na wɔtwa.
Nyankopɔn home sɛe wɔn,
na wɔhye, n’abufuo mframa ano.
Wote sɛ gyata mmobɔmu ne ɔsebɔ nne a ɛgyae,
na gyataburuwa sebɔmmɔfoɔ tutu no.
Ɛno na hanam bɛbɔ ɛserɛ-mu-sɛe ama no awu,
na gyatabereɛ mma abɔ pete.

Na me deɛ, asɛm bi wiawiaa ne ho baa me nkyɛn,
na m’aso tee ɛho asomusɛm bi.
Ɔdadwene a ɛfiri anadwo adehunu mu mu,
berɛ a nnahɔɔ atɔ nnipa soɔ no,
ehu ne ahopopoɔ kaa me,
na ɛmaa me nnompe nyinaa wosoe.
Na honhom bi twaa mu faa m’ani so,
me ho nwi nyinaa sɔre gyinagyinae,
ɛgyinae,
nanso manhunu ne su,
suban bi gyinagyina m’ani so,
metee nne bɔkɔɔ bi sɛ:
Ɔdasani tene sene Onyankopɔn,
anaa onipa ho te sene ne yɛfoɔ?
Hwɛ, ne nkoa mpo, ɔmfa ne ho nto wɔn so,
na n’abɔfoɔ no, ɔbu wɔn sɛ wɔtɔ mu;
na nkantom wɔn a wɔte dɔteɛ adan mu,
na wɔn nnyinasoɔ wɔ mfuturo mu,
na wɔfurofuro wɔn sɛ abubummabaa.
Ɛfiri anɔpa kɔsi anwummerɛ na wɔaposa wɔn;
wɔyera korakora a obi nnwene ho.
Sɛ wɔtete wɔn ho ntomadan homa a,
ɛnyɛ wuo na wɔwuo a wɔanhunu nyansa biara?

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
